The '''Blitz on Kormoran''' occurred during the first [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the strike, [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] were ordered to attack refugees on the terrestrial object [[Kormoran]], resulting in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of 90,000 people. After the attack, it was rumored that a participating [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[TIE pilot]] defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and would later become an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="Trooper" />
